English: This chapter focuses on the practical achievements of existing Africa–Europe science, technology and innovation (STI) projects.
Luganda: Essuula eno ekwata ku bituukiddwako mu pulojekiti za saayansi, tekinologia n’okuvumbula (STI) eziriwo mu Afirika ne Bulaaya.
Yoruba: Abala ìwé yìí fojú sí àṣeyọrí tí sáyẹ́nsì Áfíríkà-Europe tó wà tẹ́lẹ̀ ti ṣe, iṣé àkànṣe ìmọ̀tuntun àti ìmọ-ẹ̀rọ (STI).
Zulu: Lesi sahluko sigxile empumelelweni ebonakalayo yamaphrojekthi akhona ase-Afrika-Europe ezesayensi, ezobuchwepheshe kanye nokusungula izinto ezintsha (STI).
Hausa: Wannan babin yana mayar da hankali ne a kan nasarorin da ake samu na wanzazzun ayyukan kimiyya da fasaha da ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire (STI) na Afirka da Turai.
Northern Sotho: Kgaolo ye e lebeletše kudu go diphihlelelo tše di bonwago tša diprotšekeng tša bjale tša mahlale, theknolotši le boitlhamelo(STI) ka Afrika le Yuropa.
Amharic: ይህ ምዕራፍ በነባር አፍሪካ-አውሮፓ ሳይንስ፣ ቴክኖሎጂ እና ፈጠራ (ሳ.ቴ.ፈ) ፕሮጀክቶች ተግባራዊ ስኬቶች ላይ ያተኩራል።

English: It reviews six programmes that fund Africa–Europe STI cooperation, highlighting some of their successful cooperative projects, particularly in the fields of new water and sanitation technologies and green chemicals.
Luganda: Yeekenneenya pulogulaamu ezissa ssente mu STI mu Afirika ne Bulaaya, ng’esonga ku pulojekiti zaayo ezirina we zituuse, okusingira ddala mu bisaawe bya tekinologiya w’amazzi amapya n’obuyonjo n’okukendeeza ebiragala.
Yoruba: Ó ṣàfihàn àwọn ètò mẹ́fà tó ń bu owó fún ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ STI Áfíríkà-Europe, ṣíṣe àtòjọ àwọn iṣẹ́ àkànse ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ tí wọ́n ṣe, pàápàá jùlọ ní ẹ̀ka omi titun àti ìmọ̀-ẹ̀rọ fún ìmọ́tótó àti kẹ́míkà-apa-ohun-ewu.
Zulu: Ibuyekeza izinhlelo eziyisithupha ezixhasa ngezimali ukubambisana kwe-Afrika-Europe nge-STI, igqamisa eminye yemiklamo yabo yokubambisana eyimpumelelo, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni yobuchwepheshe obusha bamanzi nokuthuthwa kwendle namakhemikhali aluhlaza.
Hausa: Yana bitar shirye-shirye shida da suke bayar da gudummawar haɗin gwiwar Afirka da Turai STI, tare da bayyana wasu ayyukan haɗin gwiwa da suka samu nasara, musamman a fannonin sababbin fasahohin ruwa da tsaftar muhalli da kuma korayen sinadarai.
Northern Sotho: E lekodišiša mananeo a tshela ao a thušago ka ditšhelete tirišano ka ga STI magareng ga Afrika le Yuropa, gomme e laetša tše dingwe tša diprotšeke tša bona tše di atlegilego, kudukudu ka makaleng a a ditheknolotši tše diswa tša meetse le kelelatšhila le dikhemikhale tša go sepelelana le tikologo.
Amharic: በተለይም በአዳዲስ የውሃ እና የአካባቢ ንፅህና ቴክኖሎጂ መስኮች እና በአረንጓዴ ኬሚካሎች ዙሪያ የተሳኩ የትብብር ፕሮጀክቶቻቸውን በማጉላት ለአፍሪካ-አውሮፓ የሳ.ቴ.ፈ ትብብር ድጋፍ የሚሰጡ ስድስት ፕሮግራሞችን ይገመግማል።

English: This practical focus sheds light on the intrinsically unequal cooperation patterns among African countries.
Luganda: Okwekaliriza kuno kutangaaza ku nkolagana etenkanankana wakati w’amawanga ga Afirika.
Yoruba: Àfojúsùn iṣẹ́ yìí tan ìmọ́lẹ̀ sí ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ aláìdọ́gba láàárín àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Lokhu kugxila okusebenzayo kunikeza ukukhanya emaphethini okubambisana angalingani phakathi kwamazwe ase-Afrika.
Hausa: Wannan mayar da hankali a aikace yana bayar da haske a kan yanayin haɗin gwiwar da take a tsakanin ƙasashen Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Nepišo ye ya tiragalo e sedimoša mabapi le mekgwa ya tirišano ye e bonagalago e sa lekane gareng ga dinaga tša Afrika.
Amharic: ይህ ተግባራዊ ትኩረት በአፍሪካ ሃገራት መካከል ባለው ውስጣዊ እኩልነት የጎደለው የትብብር ዘይቤን ያብራራል።

English: Participation of a diverse range of African partners, and private sector participation in Africa–EU STI cooperation, remain limited.
Luganda: Obwetabi bw’amawanga ga Afirika ag’enjawulo, n’obwetabi bwa banneekoleragyange mu nkolagana ya Afirika ne Bulaaya mu STI, bukyali butono.
Yoruba: Ìwọ̀n sì ni kíkópa àwọn oríṣiríṣi alábàásepọ̀ Áfíríkà àti kíkópa àwọn ẹ̀ka aládàáni ní ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ Áfíríkà-EU STI jẹ́.
Zulu: Ukubamba iqhaza kozakwethu abahlukahlukene base-Afrika, nokubamba iqhaza kwemboni ezimele ekusebenzisaneni kwe-Afrika ne-EU STI, kusalokhu kunomkhawulo.
Hausa: Kasancewa da damammaki na abokan hulda na Afirka, da sa hannun kamfanoni masu zaman kansu a cikin haɗin gwiwar Afirka da EU na STI, ya kasance yana da iyaka.
Northern Sotho: Go kgatha tema ga mehutahuta ye e fapanego ya badirišani ba ka Afrika, le go kgatha tema ga lekala la phraebete ka tirišanong ya Afrika–EU STI, go sa dutše go sa hlaelela.
Amharic: የተለያዩ የአፍሪካ አጋሮች ተሳትፎ እና የግሉ ዘርፍ በአፍሪካ-አ.ህ ሳ.ቴ.ፈ ትብብር ውስጥ ያለው ተሳትፎ ውስን እንደሆነ ነው።

English: The authors thus point out that future cooperation should focus on how to market and disseminate STI products and services.
Luganda: Abawandiisi noolwekyo balaga nti enkolagana y’ebiseera eby’omu maaso yeetaaga okussa essira ku ngeri y’okutundamu n’okutegeeza ebikolebwa n’obuweereza bwa STI.
Yoruba: Ní báyìí àwọn aṣèwádìí tọ́ka pe ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ ọjọ́ iwájú gbọ́dọ̀ ní ìfojúsùn ọ̀nà ìgbà tajà àti láti tàn iṣẹ́ àti ọjà STI ká.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke ababhali baveza ukuthi ukubambisana kwesikhathi esizayo kufanele kugxile endleleni yokuthengisa nokusabalalisa imikhiqizo nezinsizakalo ze-STI.
Hausa: Domin haka, mawallafa sun nuna cewa ya kamata haɗin gwiwa na gaba ya mayar da hankali a kan yadda za a kasuwanci da kuma yaɗa samfurori da kuma ayyuka na STI.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi le ge go le bjale ba laetša gore tirišano ya ka moso e swanetše go nepiša go ka fao mmaraka le ditšweletšwa le ditirelo tša STI di phatlalatšwago ka gona.
Amharic: ስለዚህ የወደፊት ትብብሮች የሳ.ቴ.ፈ ምርቶችን እና አገልግሎቶችን ለገበያ የማቅረብ እና የማሰራጨት መንገዶች ላይ ማተኮር እንዳለባቸው ጸሐፊዎቹ ይጠቁማሉ።

English: Authors of a chapter in a book about Africa-Europe research collaborations say several joint science, technology and innovation projects (STI) have been successful.
Luganda: Abawandiisi b’essuula mu kitabo ekikwata ku nkolagana mu kunoonyereza wakati wa Afirika ne Bulaaya bagamba nti pulojekiti ez’awamu nnyingi ku saayansi, tekinologia n’okuvumbula (STI) zitambudde bulungi.
Yoruba: Òǹkọ̀wé abala kan nínú ìwé tó sọ nípa àjọṣepọ̀ ìwádìí Áfíríkà-Europe sọ pé ọ̀pọ̀ àjọṣe iṣẹ́-àkànṣẹ sáyẹ́ńsì, ìmọ̀-ẹrọ àti ìmọtuntun (STI) ni ó jẹ́ àṣeyọrí.
Zulu: Ababhali besahluko sencwadi emayelana nokusebenzisana kocwaningo lwe-Afrika-Europe bathi amaphrojekthi ambalwa ahlangene esayensi, ezobuchwepheshe kanye nokusungula izinto ezintsha (STI) abe yimpumelelo.
Hausa: Marubutan wani babi a wani littafi game da haɗin gwiwar bincike na Afirka da Turai sun ce ayyukan haɗin gwiwa da dama na kimiyya da fasaha da kuma ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire (STI) sun yi nasara.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba kgaolo ya ka pukung ka ga ditirišano ka ga dinyakišišo magareng ga Afrika le Yuropa ba bolela gore diprotšeke tše mmalwa tša mohlakanelwa ka ga mahlale, theknolotši le boitlhamelo (STI) di ile tša atlega.
Amharic: በአንድ ስለ አፍሪካ-አውሮፓ ምርምር ትብብር የተጻፈ መጽሀፍ ውስጥ የአንድ ምዕራፍ ጸሐፊዎች በርካታ የሳይንስ፣ ቴክኖሎጂ እና ፈጠራ ፕሮጀክቶች (ሳ.ቴ.ፈ) ስኬታማ መሆናቸውን ተናግረዋል።

English: But with little private sector involvement, many of these fail to reach the market.
Luganda: Naye olw’obuteetabaamu bulungi banneekoleragyange, nnyingi ku zino ziremererwa okutuuka mu katale.
Yoruba: Ṣùgbọ́n pẹ̀lú àìfi taratara dásí àwọn ẹ̀ka aládàáni, ọ̀pọ̀ ni kò dé ọjà fún títà.
Zulu: Kodwa ngokubandakanyeka okuncane kwezinkampani ezizimele, eziningi zazo ziyehluleka ukufinyelela emakethe.
Hausa: Amma tare da sa hannun kamfanoni masu zaman kansu kaɗan, yawancin waɗannan sun kasa isa kasuwa.
Northern Sotho: Eupša ge lekala la phraebete le kgatha tema gannyane, bontši bja tšona di a palelwa go fihlelela mmaraka.
Amharic: ነገር ግን በአናሳ የግል ዘርፍ ተሳትፎ ምክንያት ከእነዚህ ውስጥ ብዙዎቹ ገበያ ላይ መድረስ አልቻሉም።

English: The authors also called for more equal participation of African countries.
Luganda: Abawandiisi era baasaba wabeewo okwetabamu okwenkanankana okw’amawanga ga Afirika.
Yoruba: Àwọn òǹkọ̀wé náà pè fún ìkópa tí ó dọ́gba láàárín àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Ababhali baphinde bacela ukuba amazwe ase-Afrika abambe iqhaza ngokulinganayo.
Hausa: Marubutan sun kuma yi kira da a ƙara haɗa kai a tsakanin ƙasashen Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Bangwadi ba ile gape ba ipiletša gore go be le go kgatha tema ka fao go lekanego ga dinaga tša Afrika.
Amharic: የአፍሪካ ሃገራት የበለጠ እኩል ተሳትፎ እንዲኖራቸው ጸሐፊዎቹ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል።

English: They described projects under the seventh framework programme (FP7); Horizon 2020; the Cooperation in Science and Technology (COST) programme; Eurostars; the African, Caribbean and Pacific (ACP) programme, the European & Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership (EDCTP); and the African Union Research Grants (AURG).
Luganda: Bannyonnyola pulojekiti eziri wansi wa seventh framework programme (FP7); Horizon 2020; Cooperation in Science and Technology (COST) programme; Eurostars; African, Caribbean and Pacific (ACP) programme, European & Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership (EDCTP); ne African Union Research Grants (AURG).
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àpèjúwe iṣẹ́ àkànṣe sí abẹ́ ètò ìlànà kéje (FP7); Horizon 2020; ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ inú ètò sáyẹ́nsì, àti ìmọ̀-ẹ̀rọ (COST); Eurostars; ètò Áfíríkà Caribbean àti Pacific (ACP), Àjọṣepò ìwádìí Europe àti àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè tí ó ń dàgbà (EDCTP); àti owó ìṣèwádìí ẹgbé Áfíríkà (AURG).
Zulu: Bachaza amaphrojekthi ngaphansi kohlelo lohlaka lwesikhombisa (FP7); I-Horizon 2020; Uhlelo Lokubambisana Kwezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe (COST); Eurostars; uhlelo lwe-Afrika, i-Caribbean kanye ne-Pacific (ACP), i-European & Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership (EDCTP); kanye Nezibonelelo Zocwaningo Lwenyunyana Yase-Afrika (i-AURG).
Hausa: Sun bayyana ayyukan da suke ƙarƙashin shirin na bakwai (FP7); Horizon 2020; Shirin Haɗin kai a Kimiyya da Fasaha (COST); Eurostars; shirin Afirka, Caribbean da kuma Pacific (ACP), Ƙungiyar Haɗin Gwiwar Gwaje-Gwajen Likitanci na Tarayyar Turai da Ƙasashe Masu Tasowa (EDCTP); da kuma Tallafin Bincike na Tarayyar Afirka (AURG).
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba hlaloša diprotšeke ka fase ga lenaneo la tlhako ya bošupa (FP7); Horizon 2020; Lenaneo la Tirišano go tša Mahlale le Theknolotši (COST); Eurostars; Lenaneo la Afrika, Caribbean le Pacific (ACP), Selekane ka ga Diteko tša Kalafo sa Yuropa le Dinaga tše di Hlabologago (EDCTP); le Diputseletšo tša Dinyakišišo tša Mokgatlo wa Selekane sa Afrika (AURG).
Amharic: በሰባተኛው ማእቀፍ ፕሮግራም (ማ.ፕ7)፤ ሆራይዘን 2020፤ የሳይንስ እና ቴክኖሎጂ ትብብር (ሳ.ቴ.ት) ፕሮግራም፤ ኢዩሮስታርስ፤ የአፍሪካን፣ የካሪቢያን እና የፓሲፊክ (አ.ካ.ፓ) ፕሮግራም፤ የአውሮፓ እና በማደግ ላይ ያሉ ሃገራት ክሊኒካዊ ሙከራዎች አጋርነት (አ.ማ.ሃ.ክ.ሙ.አ)፤ እና የአፍሪካ ህብረት የምርምር እርዳታ (አ.ህ.ም.እ) ስር ያሉ ፕሮጀክቶችን ገለጹ።

English: While many projects were successful, the researchers noted that in general, participation by diverse African countries and by the private sector could have been better.
Luganda: Newankubadde nga pulojekiti nnyingi zaakola bulungi, abanoonyereza baakizuula nti okutwaliza awamu, obwetabi bw’amawanga ag’enjawulo ne banneekoleragyange bwandibadde busingawo.
Yoruba: Nígbà tí ọ̀pọ̀ iṣé-àkànṣe jẹ́ àṣeyọrí, àwọn aṣèwádìí wòye pé ní gbogbogbò, kíkópa àwọn oríṣiríṣi orílẹ̀-èdè ní Áfíríkà àti àwọn ẹ̀ka aládàáni lè jẹ́ kí ó dára sí i.
Zulu: Nakuba amaphrojekthi amaningi abe yimpumelelo, abacwaningi baphawula ukuthi ngokujwayelekile, ukubamba iqhaza kwamazwe ahlukene ase-Afrika kanye nezinkampani ezizimele bekungaba ngcono.
Hausa: Duk da yake ayyuka da yawa sun yi nasara, masu binciken sun lura cewa gabaɗaya, shigar da ƙasashen Afirka daban-daban da kuma ɓangarori masu zaman kansu zai iya zama mafi kyau.
Northern Sotho: Le ge e le gore diprotšeke tše ntši di ile tša atlega, banyakišiši ba ile ba lemoga gore ka kakaretšo, go kgatha tema ga dinaga tše di farologanego tša Afrika le ka lekala la phraebete go ka be go bile kaone.
Amharic: በርካታ ፕሮጀክቶች ውጤታማ ቢሆኑም በአጠቃላይ በተለያዩ የአፍሪካ ሃገራት እና በግሉ ዘርፍ ተሳትፎ የተሻለ ሊሆን ይችል እንደነበር ተመራማሪዎቹ ጠቁመዋል።

English: They mentioned examples like the AfriAlliance project between Europe and Africa (South Africa, Ghana and others), which prepares Africa for future climate challenges.
Luganda: Baawa ebyokulabirako nga pulojekiti ya AfriAlliance wakati wa Bulaaya ne Afirika (South Africa, Ghana n’amalala), eteekateeka Afirika okwaŋŋanga okusoomoozebwa kw’enkyukakyuka y’embeera y’obudde mu biseera ebijja.
Yoruba: Wọ́n dárúkọ àwọn àpẹẹrẹ bí i iṣé-àkànṣe AfriAlliance láàárín Europe àti Áfíríkà (South Áfíríkà, Ghana àti àwọn mìíràn), èyí tí ó pèsè Áfíríkà sílẹ̀ fún ìpènijà ojú-ọjọ́ ní ọjọ́ iwájú.
Zulu: Nakuba amaphrojekthi amaningi abe yimpumelelo, abacwaningi baphawula ukuthi ngokuvamile, ukubamba iqhaza kwamazwe ahlukahlukene ase-Afrika kanye nezinkampani ezizimele.
Hausa: Sun ambaci misalai kamar aikin AfriAlliance a tsakanin Turai da Afirka (Afirka ta Kudu da Ghana da sauransu), wanda yake shirya Afirka don ƙalubalolin yanayi na gaba.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba fa mehlala ya go swana le protšeke tša Tirišano ya ka Afrika magareng ga Yuropa le Afrika (e lego Afrika Borwa, Ghana le tše dingwe), yeo e lokišetšago Afrika go ditlhohlo tša ka moso tša tlelaemete.
Amharic: በአውሮፓ እና በአፍሪካ (ደቡብ አፍሪካ፣ ጋና እና ሌሎች) መካከል አፍሪካን ለወደፊት የአየር ንብረት ተግዳሮቶች የሚያዘጋጀውን እንደ አፍሪአላያንስ ፕሮጀክት ያሉ ምሳሌዎችን ጠቅሰዋል።

English: Another project was “VicInAqua”, which aimed to develop water sanitation and treatment in agriculture, food and health security in the Victoria Lake Basin in Africa.
Luganda: Pulojekiti endala yali “VicInAqua”, ng’eno yali egenderera kukulaakulanya buyonjo bw’amazzi n’okugalongoosa mu byobulimi, emmere n’ebyobulamu mu Ttundutundu ly’Ennyanja Victoria mu Afirika.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́-àkànṣẹ mìíràn ni “VicInAqua” ẹ̀yí tí ó gbèrò àti mú ìdàgbàsókè bá ìmọ́tótó omi àti ìtọ́jú àwọn ohun ọ̀gbìn, ètò àbò fún oújẹ àti ìlera ní Victoria Lake Basin Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Enye iphrojekthi bekuyi-"VicInAqua", ehlose ukuthuthukisa ukuthuthwa kwamanzi kanye nokwelashwa kwezolimo, ukudla kanye nokuvikeleka kwezempilo e-Victoria Lake Basin e-Afrika.
Hausa: Wani aikin kuma shi ne "VicInAqua", wanda yake da nufin haɓaka tsaftar ruwa da kula da aikin gona da abinci da lafiya a Tafkin Victoria Lake a Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Protšeke ye nngwe e bile “VicInAqua”, yeo e bego e ikemišeditve go hlama kelelatila le tlhwekišo ya go tša temo, dijo le tšhireletšego go tša maphelo ka Victoria Lake Basin ka Africa.
Amharic: ሌላው ፕሮጀክት “ቪሲንአኩዋ” ነበር፤ ይህም በቪክቶሪያ ሐይቅ ተፋሰስ የውሃ ንፅህናን እና ህክምናን በግብርና፣ በምግብ እና በጤና ደህንነት ለማዳበር ያለመ ነበር።

English: Countries like Uganda and Kenya were working with Europe to make a self-cleaning water filter.
Luganda: Amawanga nga Uganda ne Kenya gaali gakolagana ne Bulaaya okukola ekkenenulo ly’amazzi erikola lyokka.
Yoruba: Àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè bí i Uganda àti Kenya ń bá Europe ṣiṣẹ́ láti ṣe asẹ́ fún ìmọ́toto omi wọn.
Zulu: Amazwe afana ne-Uganda neKenya ayesebenzisana ne-Europe ukwenza isisefo samanzi esizihlanzayo.
Hausa: Ƙasashe kamar Yuganda da Kenya suna aiki tare da Turai don tace ruwa mai tsabta.
Northern Sotho: Dinaga tša go swana le Uganda le Kenya di be di šomišana le Yuropa go dira sefo ya meetse ya go itlhwekiša.
Amharic: እንደ ኡጋንዳ እና ኬኒያ ያሉ ሃገራት እራሱን የሚያጸዳ የውሃ ማጣሪያ ለመስራት ከአውሮፓ ጋር ይሰሩ ነበር።

English: The COST programme started in 1971 to connect with researchers all over the world.
Luganda: Pulogulaamu ya COST yatandika mu 1971 okukwatagana n’abanoonyereza mu nsi yonna.
Yoruba: Ọdún 1971 ni ètò COST bèrè sí ní sopò mọ́ àwọn aṣèwádìí káàkiri àgbáyé.
Zulu: Uhlelo lwe-COST lwaqala ngo-1971 ukuze luxhumane nabacwaningi emhlabeni wonke.
Hausa: Shirin COST ya fara a shekarar 1971 don haɗuwa da masu bincike a duk faɗin duniya.
Northern Sotho: Lenaneo la COST le thomilwe ka 1971 go kgokagana le banyakišiši lefaseng ka bophara.
Amharic: የሳ.ቴ.ት ፕሮግራም በዓለም ዙሪያ ካሉ ተመራማሪዎች ጋር ለመገናኘት በ1971 ተጀመረ።

English: They don’t fund research, but they help with developing networks that can lead to funding.
Luganda: Tebassa ssente mu kunoonyereza, naye bayamba mu kussaawa enkolagana ezisobola okuvaamu okufuna ssente.
Yoruba: Wọn kì í gbé owó sílẹ̀ fún iṣẹ́ ìwádìí, ṣùgbọ́n wọ́n máa ń ṣe ìrànlọ́wọ́ pẹ̀lú àwọn nẹ́tíwọ́kì tó ń ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ ń dàgbàsókè tó lè sètò owó.
Zulu: Abaxhasi ucwaningo, kodwa basiza ekuthuthukiseni amanethiwekhi angaholela ekuxhasweni.
Hausa: Ba sa bayar da kuɗin bincike, amma suna taimakawa tare da haɓaka cibiyoyin sadarwa waɗanda za su iya samun kuɗi.
Northern Sotho: Ga ga thekge dinyakišišo ka ditšhelete, eupša ba thuša ka go hloma dinetweke tšeo di ka feleletšago ka thušo ya ditšhelete.
Amharic: ለምርምር የገንዘብ ድጋፍ አይሰጡም ነገር ግን ወደ ገንዘብ ድጋፍ የሚያመሩ አውታረ መረቦችን በማዘጋጀት ይረዳሉ።

English: Ethiopia, South Africa, Sudan and a few other African countries are involved.
Luganda: Ethiopia, South Afirika, Sudan n’amawanga amalala mu Afirika geenyigiramu.
Yoruba: Àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè bí i Ethiopia, South Africa, Sudan àti àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè ni wọ́n lọ́wọ́ sí i.
Zulu: I-Ethiopia, iNingizimu Afrika, iSudan namanye amazwe ambalwa ase-Afrika ayabandakanyeka.
Hausa: Ƙasashen Habasha da Afirka ta Kudu da Sudan da wasu ‘yan tsirarun ƙasashen Afirka sun shiga.
Northern Sotho: Ethiopia, Afrika Borwa, Sudan le dinaga tše dingwe tše mmalwa tša Afrika le tšona di kgatha tema.
Amharic: ኢትዮጵያ፣ ደቡብ አፍሪካ፣ ሱዳን እና ሌሎች ጥቂት የአፍሪካ ሃገራት ተሳትፈዋል።

English: Green chemistry, which is the process of making and using safe chemicals, is a part of this programme between the UK and Ethiopia.
Luganda: Enkola y’okukendeeza ebiragala mu kufulumya ebintu (green chemistry) y’emu ku biri mu pulogulaamu eno wakati wa Bungereza ne Ethiopia.
Yoruba: Kẹ́místírì ìdẹ́kun ìpalára, èyí ni ìlànà ṣíṣe àti lílò àwọn kẹ́míkà tí kò panilára, ó jẹ́ ọ̀kan lára ètò tó wà láàárín UK àti Ethiopia.
Zulu: Ikhemistri eluhlaza, okuyinqubo yokwenza nokusebenzisa amakhemikhali aphephile, iyingxenye yalolu hlelo phakathi kwe-UK ne-Ethiopia.
Hausa: Green chemistry, wanda shi ne tsari na ƙera da amfani da sinadarai masu aminci, wani ɓangare ne na wannan shiri a tsakanin Burtaniya da kuma Habasha.
Northern Sotho: Khemistri ya go sepelelana le tikologo, ye e lego tshepedišo ya go dira le go šomiša dikghemikhale tše di bolokegilego, ke karolo ya lenaneo le magareng ga UK le Ethiopia.
Amharic: ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ ኬሚካሎችን የማምረት እና የመጠቀም ሂደት የሆነው አረንጓዴ ኬሚስትሪ የዚህ በእንግሊዝ እና በኢትዮጵያ መካከል ያለው ፕሮግራም አካል ነው።

English: It made people aware about using safe chemicals and showed Ethiopian innovation.
Luganda: Yasobozesa abantu okutegeera ebikwata ku kukozesa ebiragala ebitalina bulabe era n’eraga okuvumbula kwa Ethiopia.
Yoruba: Ó máa ń jẹ́kí àwọn èèyàn mọ̀ nípa ìlò àwọn kẹ́míkà tí kò pani lára ó sì ṣe àfihàn ìmọ̀tuntun ti Ethiopia.
Zulu: Yenze abantu baqaphele ngokusebenzisa amakhemikhali aphephile futhi yabonisa ukusungulwa kwe-Ethiopian.
Hausa: Ya sanar da mutane game da amfani da sinadarai masu aminci kuma ya nuna ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire na ƙasar Habasha.
Northern Sotho: Le dirile gore batho ba tsebe ka ga go šomiša dikhemikhale tše di bolokegilego la laetša eboiutlhamelo bja Ethiopia.
Amharic: ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ ኬሚካሎችን ስለመጠቀም ሰዎች እንዲገነዘቡ እና የኢትዮጵያ ፈጠራን አሳይቷል።

English: Eurostars' joint programme began in 2008 to support international projects by small and medium sized businesses in research and development.
Luganda: Pulogulaamu ya Eurostars ey’awamu yatandika mu 2008 okuyamba pulojekiti z'ensi yonna ne bizineesi entono n’ennenenene mu kunoonyereza n'enkulaakulana.
Yoruba: Ọdun 2008 ni àjọṣe ètò Eurostars bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ní ran àwọn iṣẹ́-àkànṣe ilẹ-òkèèrè lọ́wọ́ nípa ìwádìí àti ìdàgbàsókè àwọn okòòwò kékeré àti èyí tí kò fi bẹ́ẹ̀ gbòòrò.
Zulu: Uhlelo oluhlanganyelwe lwe-Eurostars lwaqala ngo-2008 ukusekela amaphrojekthi wamazwe ngamazwe amabhizinisi amancane naphakathi ocwaningweni nasekuthuthukisweni.
Hausa: Shirin haɗin gwiwa na Eurostars ya fara a cikin shekarar 2008 don tallafawa ayyukan ƙasa-da-ƙasa na ƙanana da matsakaitan ’yan kasuwa a cikin bincike da kuma haɓakawa.
Northern Sotho: Lenaneo la mohlakanelwa la Eurostars le thomile ka 2008 go thekga diprotšeke tša boditšhabatšhaba ka dikgwebopotlana le dikgwebo tša magareng ka dinyakišišong le ka tlhabollong.
Amharic: የኢዩሮስታርስ የጋራ ፕሮግራም በጥናት እና በልማት ላይ በአነስተኛ እና መካከለኛ ንግዶች ዓለም አቀፍ ፕሮጀክቶችን ለመደገፍ በ2008 ተጀመረ።

English: The goal was to bring the products or services to European and international markets.
Luganda: Ekiruubirirwa kyali okutwala ebyamaguzi n’obuweereza ku katale ka Bulaaya n’ak’ensi yonna.
Yoruba: Àfojúsùn ni láti mú àwọn ọjà tàbí iṣẹ́ náà lọ sí Europe àti àwọn ọjà ilẹ-òkèèrè.
Zulu: Umgomo bekuwukuletha imikhiqizo noma izinsizakalo ezimakethe zaseYurophu nezamazwe ngamazwe.
Hausa: Manufar ita ce kawo samfuran ko ayyukan zuwa kasuwannin Turai da ma na duniya.
Northern Sotho: Maikemišetšo e bile go tliša ditšweletšwa goba ditirelo go mebaraka ya ka Yuropa le ya boditšhabatšhaba.
Amharic: ግቡ ምርቶቹን ወይም አገልግሎቶቹን ወደ አውሮፓ እና ዓለም አቀፍ ገበያዎች ማምጣት ነበር።

English: South Africa is a part of the MINWARE project to come up with environmentally friendly solutions for wastewater from mining and metal industries.
Luganda: South Afirika eri mu pulojekiti ya MINWARE okufuna eby’okuddamu ebitakosa butonde bwa nsi ku mazzi agakozeseddwa okuva mu makolero g’ebirombe n’ebyuma.
Yoruba: South Áfíríkà wà lára iṣẹ́-àkànṣe MINWARE tó gbèrò ọ̀nà àti tán ìṣòro omi ìdọ̀tí tó ń jáde látara wíwa ìṣúra àti ilé-iṣẹ́ àlùrọ tó dára fún àyíká.
Zulu: INingizimu Afrika iyingxenye yephrojekthi ye-MINWARE yokuqhamuka nezisombululo ezingayingeni imvelo yamanzi angcolile avela ezimbonini zezimayini nezensimbi.
Hausa: Afirka ta Kudu wani ɓangare ne na aikin MINWARE don fito da hanyoyin da ba su dace da muhalli ba don ruwan sha daga masana'antar haƙar ma'adinai da ƙarafa.
Northern Sotho: Afrika Borwa ke karolo ya protšeke ya MINWARE yeo e tlilego ka ditharollo tša go ba le segwera go tikologo tša meetse a ditšhila a go tšwa ka meepong le ka diintastering tša ditšhipi.
Amharic: ደቡብ አፍሪካ ከማዕ አድን እና ከብረታ ብረት ኢንዱስትሪዎች ለሚወጣ ቆሻሻ ውሃ ለአካባቢ ተስማሚ መፍትሄዎችን ለማምጣት የሚሰራው የሚንዌር ፕሮጀክት አካል ነች።

English: They are also part of the VitaSOFT project, which focuses on treatments for waste from mines.
Luganda: Era eri mu pulojekiti ya VitaSOFT, ng’eno essa essira ku kulongoosa kasasiro ava mu birombe.
Yoruba: Bẹ́ẹ̀ náà ni wọ́n wà lára iṣẹ́ àkànṣe VitaSOFT, èyí tí ó kọjú mọ́ ìtọ́jú àwọn ẹ̀gbin tó jáde láti ara wíwa ìṣura.
Zulu: Futhi bayingxenye yephrojekthi ye-VitaSOFT, egxile ekwelashweni kwemfucuza evela ezimayini.
Hausa: Har ila yau, suna cikin aikin VitaSOFT, wanda ke mayar da hankali kan maganin sharar gida daga ma'adinai.
Northern Sotho: Gape ke karolo ya protšeke ya VitaSOFT, yeo e lebeletšego ditlhwekišo tša ditšhila tše di tšwago ka meepong.
Amharic: እንዲሁም ከማዕድን ማውጫዎች የሚወጡ ቆሻሻዎች ህክምናዎች ላይ የሚያተኩረው የቪያሶፍት ፕሮጀክት አካልም ናቸው።

English: They also mentioned the ACP S&T programme, which was made to support science, technology and innovation in Africa, Caribbean and Pacific countries.
Luganda: Era baayogera ku pulogulaamu ya ACP S&T, eyakolebwa okuyamba ku saayansi, tekinologia n’okuvumbula mu mawanga ga Afirika, Caribbean ne Pacific.
Yoruba: Wọ́n mẹ́nu ba ètò ACP S&T, èyí tí wọ́n dá sílẹ̀ láti ran sáyẹ́nsì, ìmọ̀-ẹ̀rọ àti ìmọ̀tuntun ní Áfíríkà, Carribbean àti àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè Pacific lọ́wọ́.
Zulu: Baphinde bakhuluma ngohlelo lwe-ACP S&T, olwenzelwe ukweseka isayensi, ezobuchwepheshe kanye nokusungula izinto ezintsha emazweni ase-Afrika, eCaribbean nasePacific.
Hausa: Haka nan kuma, sun ambaci shirin ACP S&T, wanda aka yi don tallafawa kimiyya da fasaha da ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire a ƙasashen Afirka, Caribbean da kuma Pacific.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gape ka ga lenaneo la ACP S&T, leo le ilego la dirwa gore le thekge mahlale, theknolotši le boitlhamelo ka Afrika, dinaga tša Caribbean le tša Pacific.
Amharic: በአፍሪካ፣ በካሪቢያን እና በፓሲፊክ ሃገራት ሳይንስን፣ ቴክኖሎጂን እና ፈጠራን ለመደገፍ የተሰራውን አ.ካ.ፓ ሳ.ቴ ፕሮግራምንም ጠቅሰዋል።

English: The WABEF project was part of this programme, and looked at ways to recycle organic matter and make energy and fertiliser in West African countries like Senegal, Benin and Mali.
Luganda: Pulojekiti ya WABEF yali mu pulogulaamu eno, era yatunuulira engeri z’okuddamu okukozesa ebintu ebiramu n’okukola amasannyalaze n’ebigimusa mu mawanga g’Obugwanjuba bwa Afirika nga Senegal, Benin ne Mali.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ àkànṣe WABEF wà lára ètò yìí, ó sì ń wo ọ̀nà àti ṣẹ àtúnlò àwọn ohun ọ̀gáníìkì láti pèsè agbára àti ajílè ní àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè Ìwọ̀ oòrùn Áfíríkà bí i Senegal, Benin àti Mali.
Zulu: Iphrojekthi ye-WABEF ibiyingxenye yalolu hlelo, futhi ibheke izindlela zokuvuselela izinto eziphilayo kanye nokwenza amandla nomanyolo emazweni aseNtshonalanga Afrika njengeSenegal, Benin neMali.
Hausa: Aikin WABEF na cikin wannan shiri, kuma ya duba hanyoyin sake sarrafa ƙwayoyin halitta da samar da makamashi da taki a ƙasashen yammacin Afirka kamar Senegal da Benin da kuma Mali.
Northern Sotho: Protšeke ya WABEF e bile karolo ya lenaneo le, gomme ya lebelela ditsela tša go diriša leswa dilo tša tlhago le enetši le manyora ka dinageng tša Boduikela bja Afrika tša go swana le Senegal, Benin le Mali.
Amharic: የዋቤፍ ፕሮጀክት የዚህ ፕሮግራም አካል ሲሆን እንደ ሴኔጋል፣ ቤኒን እና ማሊ በመሳሰሉ የምዕራብ አፍሪካ ሃገራት ኦርጋኒክ ቁስን መልሶ ጥቅም ላይ የማዋል እና ሃይል እና ማዳበሪያ የመስራት መንገዶችን ተመልክቷል።

English: Another project used leftover or underused species in agriculture across Africa.
Luganda: Pulojekiti endala yakozesa ebika by’ebirime ebitakozesebwa oba ebikozesebwa ekitono okwetooloola Afirika.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ àkànṣe mìíràn lo àlòkù tàbí ẹ̀yà inú ohun ọ̀gbìn tí wọn kò lò dáadáa káàkiri Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Enye iphrojekthi esetshenziswa izinhlobo ezisele noma ezingasetshenziswa kancane kwezolimo e-Afrika yonkana.
Hausa: Wani aikin kuma ya yi amfani da ragowar ko jinsunan da ba a yi amfani da su sosai ba a harkar noma a faɗin Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Protšeke ye nngwe e šomišite dilahlwa goba mehuta ye e sego ya šomišwa ka moka ya tša temo go ralala le Afrika.
Amharic: ሌላው ፕሮጀክት በመላው አፍሪካ ከግብርና የተረፉትን ወይም በበቂ ሁኔታ ጥቅም ላይ ያልዋሉትን ዝርያዎች ተጠቅሟል።

English: Yet another, called EDCTP, began in 2003 to target diseases like HIV/AIDS, TB and Malaria.
Luganda: So ng’endala, eyitibwa EDCTP, yatandika mu 2003 ng’etunuulira endwadde nga HIV/Mukenenya, akafuba n’omusujja gw’ensiri.
Yoruba: Wọ́ dá òmíràn sílẹ̀ tí wọ́n pe orúkọ rẹ̀ ní EDCTP, ní ọdún 2003 tí àfojúsùn rẹ̀ jẹ́ àwọn àrùn bí i HIV/AIDS, TB àti ibà.
Zulu: Enye futhi, ebizwa nge-EDCTP, yaqala ngo-2003 ukukhomba izifo ezifana ne-HIV/AIDS, TB kanye nomalaleveva.
Hausa: Wani kuma, wanda ake kira EDCTP, ya fara shekarar 2003 domin cututtuka kamar HIV/AIDS, TB da kuma Zazzaɓin Cizon Sauro.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale ye nngwe, ye e bitšwago EDCTP, e ile ya thoma ka 2003 go nepiša malwetši a go swana le HIV/AIDS, TB le Malaria.
Amharic: በ2003 እንደ ኤችአይቪ/ኤድስ፣ ቲቢ እና የወባ በሽታ ያሉ በሽታዎችን ዒላማ ማድረግ የጀመረው ደግሞ ሌላው አ.ማ.ሃ.ክ.ሙ.አ ተብሎ የሚጠራው ነው።

English: At least 14 African countries are a part of this partnership.
Luganda: Amawanga ga Afirika waakiri 14 gali mu nkolagana eno.
Yoruba: Ó kéré tán, orílẹ̀-èdè 14 ló darapọ̀ mọ́ àjọṣepọ̀ yìí.
Zulu: Amazwe ase-Afrika angekho ngaphansi kwayi-14 ayingxenye yalobu budlelwano.
Hausa: Aƙalla ƙasashen Afirka guda 14 ne suke cikin wannan ƙawance.
Northern Sotho: Bonyane dinaga tše 14 tša Afrika ke karolo ya selekane se.
Amharic: ቢያንስ 14 የአፍሪካ ሃገራት የዚህ አጋርነት አካል ናቸው።

English: One of the projects in this programme is ENDORSE, which involves Europe and Uganda in training healthcare workers in the safety and protection against these diseases.
Luganda: Emu ku pulojekiti ezi mu pulogulaamu eno ye ENDORSE, ng’eno erimu Bulaaya ne Uganda mu kutendeka abasawo mu kwekuuma n’obutafuna bulabe buva ku ndwadde zino.
Yoruba: Ọ̀kan lára iṣẹ́ àkànṣe inú ètò yìí ni ENDORSE, èyí tí Europe àti Uganda fọwọ́ sí kíkọ́ àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìlera ní àbò àti ọ̀nà àìléwu à ti dojú ìjà kọ àrùn.
Zulu: Enye yamaphrojekthi akulolu hlelo i-ENDORSE, ebandakanya i-Europe ne-Uganda ekuqeqesheni abasebenzi bezempilo ekuphepheni nasekuvikeleni lezi zifo.
Hausa: Ɗaya daga cikin ayyukan da suke cikin wannan shirin sh ine ENDORSE, wanda ya shafi Turai da Uganda wajen horar da ma’aikatan kiwon lafiya a cikin aminci da kariya daga waɗannan cututtuka.
Northern Sotho: Ye nngwe ya diprotšeke ka mo lenaneong le ke ENDORSE, leo le akaretšago Yuropa le Uganda ka go hlahla bašomi ba tlhokomelo ya maphelo mabapi le polokego le tšhireletšo kgahlanong le malwetši a.
Amharic: በዚህ ፕሮግራም ውስጥ ካሉት ፕሮጀክቶች አንዱ ኢንዶርስ ሲሆን በእነዚህ በሽታዎች ደህንነት እና ጥበቃ ላይ የጤና ጥበቃ ሰራተኞችን በማሰልጠን አውሮፓን እና ኡጋንዳን ያሳትፋል።

English: Based on lessons learnt from these examples, the authors recommend that future cooperation put more emphasis on how to market and disseminate STI products and services.
Luganda: Okusinziira ku byayigibwa mu byokulabirako bino, abawandiisi baasemba nti enkolagana z’ekiseera eky’omu maaso zongere okussa essira ku ngeri y’okutundamu n’okumanyisa ebikolebwa n’obuweereza bwa STI.
Yoruba: Lórí àwọn ẹ̀kọ́ tí akọ́ láti ara àwọn àpẹẹrẹ, àwọn òǹkọ̀wé dábàá pé kí àwọn ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ ọjọ́ iwájú tẹnu mọ ọ̀nà títà àti títàká àwọn ọjà àti iṣẹ́ STI.
Zulu: Ngokusekelwe ezifundweni ezitholwe kulezi zibonelo, ababhali batusa ukuthi ukubambisana kwesikhathi esizayo kugcizelele kakhulu indlela yokuthengisa nokusabalalisa imikhiqizo nezinsizakalo ze-STI.
Hausa: Dangane da darussan da aka koya daga waɗannan misalan, marubutan sun bayar da shawarar cewa haɗin gwiwa na gaba ya ƙara ba da fifiko a kan yadda ake tallatawa da kuma yaɗa samfuran STI da kuma ayyuka.
Northern Sotho: Go eya ka dithuto tše re ithutilego tšona mo go mehlala ye, bangwadi ba šišinya gore tirišano ya ka moso e beye kgatelelo ye kgolo mabapi le ka fao go ka bapatšwago le go phatlalatša ditšweletšwa le ditirelo tša STI.
Amharic: ከእነዚህ ምሳሌዎች በተወሰዱት ትምህርቶች ላይ ተመስርተው ጸሐፊዎቹ የወደፊት ትብብር የሳ.ቴ.ፈ ምርቶችን እና አገልግሎቶችን ለገበያ የማቅረብ እና የማሰራጨት መንገዶች ላይ የበለጠ ትኩረት እንዲሰጡ ይመክራሉ።

English: They say business cooperation centres can help bridge the gap between African countries and Europe.
Luganda: Bagamba nti ebifo awakwanaganyizibwa enkolagana za bizineesi bisobola okuyamba mu kuziba omuwaatwa wakati w’amawanga ga Afirika ne Bulaaya.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní kí àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ okòwò ṣe ìràlọ́wọ́ à ti wà láàárín àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè Áfíríkà àti Europe.
Zulu: Bathi izikhungo zokusebenzisana kwezamabhizinisi zingasiza ukuvala igebe phakathi kwamazwe ase-Afrika ne-Europe.
Hausa: Sun ce cibiyoyin haɗin gwiwar kasuwanci za su taimaka wajen ɗinke ɓarakar da take a tsakanin ƙasashen Afirka da kuma Turai.
Northern Sotho: Ba bolela gore mafelo a tirišano le dikgwebo a ka thuša go fediša sekgoba magareng ga dinaga tša Afrika le Yuropa.
Amharic: የንግድ ትብብር ማዕከላት በአፍሪካ ሃገራት እና በአውሮፓ መካከል ያለውን ልዩነት ለማስተካከል ይረዳሉ ይላሉ።
